description: The file export.part wrote, as read back from disk.

title.description: The document's title as SOLIDWORKS shows it.

path.description: The full path, absent while the document has never been saved.

dirty.description: True when the document has unsaved changes.

document.description: The part exported, as it is after the export: same path, same unsaved-changes flag.

header.description: The header found: ISO-10303-21;, the Parasolid transmit header, binary STL, or zip.

step_schema.description: STEP: its FILE_SCHEMA, for example AUTOMOTIVE_DESIGN { 1 0 10303 214 3 1 1 }.

preferences.description: The SOLIDWORKS export preferences set for the call and put back afterwards, each as name = value.

warnings.description: What SOLIDWORKS warned about while exporting (swFileSaveWarning_e names).

checks.description: Each check made on the file and the part, and what it found.
